## Linked issue
<!-- e.g. "Closes #123". Required unless the change is trivial (typos, broken links, small docstring fixes). -->

## Desc
<!-- What does this PR change, and why? -->

## Tests
<!-- New or changed tests, how you ran them, results. -->

<!-- Which AI tools or models did you use, and what for -->

## Checklist
- [ ] A maintainer agreed to the linked issue, or the change is trivial.
- [ ] I went through the self-review checklist in the contributor guide.
- [ ] I do not want to be listed in the release notes. (Optional)
